name: Imre Lorgrest
source:
A low-rank scout assigned to serve the main character.
He is a very private elf.
He is fancied by a few of his commanders and isn’t at all above taking advantage for his own advancement. source:https://reverie-ebon-light.fandom.com/wiki/Imre_Lorgrest

According to Laceaga, he has difficulties to control his temper.
